skills.name: pre-trade-discipline-gate
skills.description_zh: 下单前评估纪律清单，拦截无计划、超量或情绪化交易。
skills.func: 下单前按本地清单与上游闸门判定放行并记日志
skills.how: 我准备买 AAPL 了，先帮我过一遍下单前的纪律检查
skills.input: 本地清单 JSON/YAML（候选、下单意图、计划与实际风险金额等勾选项）；可选交易记忆状态目录、敞口决议 JSON、熔断决议 JSON
skills.output: JSON 与 Markdown 决议（GO/REVIEW_REQUIRED/NO_GO/NO_ACTIONABLE_ORDERS），并写 JSONL 日志；含 thesis_id 时可回链到交易记忆
skills.note: 纯离线，不接券商、不下单、不拉行情；缺上游工件时对可操作单返回 REVIEW_REQUIRED
skills.description_en: Evaluate a local pre-trade checklist before manual order entry, blocking planless, oversized, revenge-risk, market-regime-blocked, or circuit-breaker-blocked entries while journaling the decision for trader-memory-core review.

skills.name: signal-postmortem
skills.description_zh: 记录并分析交易信号的实际结果，跟踪误报与错过的机会。
skills.func: 记录信号事后结果，分类真假阳性并回馈权重与改进清单
skills.how: 把这批到期信号的复盘结果统计一下，看看哪个来源老出假信号
skills.input: 信号记录 JSON（信号ID、标的、信号日期、预测方向、来源技能、入场价等）；可选 FMP 数据源账号 自动取收益，无 Key 时手动填出场价与日期
skills.output: 事后复盘 JSON、给信号聚合器的权重调整建议 JSON、技能改进待办 YAML，以及按技能/标的/月份汇总的 Markdown 报告
skills.note: 无 数据源账号 时靠手动录入收益；权重调整要求20+样本
skills.description_en: Record and analyze post-trade outcomes for signals generated by edge pipeline and other skills. Track false positives, missed opportunities, and regime mismatches. Feed results back to edge-signal-aggregator weights and skill improvement backlog.

skills.name: stockbee-setup-fluency-trainer
skills.description_zh: 建立形态模型册并跟踪其后 3 日与 5 日表现，训练形态识别。
skills.func: 把动量爆发筛选结果建成形态模型簿并跟踪3/5日结果
skills.how: 把这些动量爆发候选建成模型簿，看看哪种形态更容易走强
skills.input: 上游动量爆发筛选器的 JSON 报告（或兼容的候选 JSON）；可选 FMP 数据源账号 或离线 OHLCV JSON 用于更新结果
skills.output: JSONL 模型簿（state/stockbee/model_book.jsonl）及摄入/更新/汇总的 JSON 与 Markdown：3日/5日收益、MFE/MAE、止损命中、结果标签、分组统计
skills.note: 需 Python 3.10+；分组统计当作证据提示，不自动改交易规则
skills.description_en: Build a Stockbee-style setup model book from momentum-burst screener candidates, then update 3-day and 5-day forward outcomes with MFE/MAE, stop-hit status, outcome tags, and cohort statistics. Use when the user wants to study Stockbee Momentum Burst examples, track failed candidates, build setup fluency, review A/B setup quality, or convert screener outputs into a learning loop rather than immediate trade signals.

skills.name: trade-performance-coach
skills.description_zh: 复盘已平仓交易，检查流程执行、风险纪律与交易行为。
skills.func: 复盘已平仓交易，评估流程与风控纪律并给出下时段规则
skills.how: 帮我复盘这笔亏损交易，看是流程问题、执行问题还是运气
skills.input: 一条已平仓交易记录或月度汇总（JSON/YAML）：计划与实际、风控计划、复盘根因与日志；可选市场状态/敞口背景
skills.output: JSON（可选 Markdown）教练报告：总体判定（OK/WARN/REVIEW_REQUIRED/RULE_VIOLATION/COOL_DOWN）、流程与风控与执行发现、行为模式标签、下时段操作规则、教练提问、人工决定闸门
skills.note: 只做流程复盘，不给买卖建议、不做心理诊断；数据缺失时默认进入复盘模式
skills.description_en: Review closed trades, partial exits, and monthly trade aggregates for process adherence, risk discipline, execution quality, and evidence-based trading behavior patterns. Use after trader-memory-core and signal-postmortem have produced records, or when the user asks for a post-trade coach, risk-manager style review, rule-adherence review, next-session operating rules, or psychology-aware trading behavior feedback. This skill does not provide buy/sell advice, therapy, or broker execution.
